items.title: Developer reports a month without AI coding tools, citing lost understanding and skill
items.summary_en: A developer who blogs as Bustikiller describes stopping AI coding tools for a month. The post says heavy agent use created an illusion of productivity while eroding understanding of the codebase and test-driven habits. The trigger was reportedly a coworker catching a flawed AI-written test. This is one personal account, not a controlled study.
items.notes: Based on search snippets only; blog and HN blocked. Post date is one day before window start. Anecdotal, single-author evidence.

coverage_note: Thin. HN, Algolia and other sources blocked by egress proxy; only snippets available. Other candidates (deadlift-form demo, LessWrong post) dropped as unverifiable. No open-source project updates verified.
